datasets.title: Sao Tome And Principe Roads (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 1.3 thousand km of roads in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 80 % of the total road length in the dataset region. The average age of data for the region is 3 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 24% of roads were added or updated in the last 6 months. Read about what this summary means : indicators , metrics This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means here ) : tags['highway'] IS NOT NULL Features may have these attributes: name name:en highway surface smoothness width lanes oneway bridge layer source name:pt This dataset is one of many OpenStreetMap exports on HDX . See the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team website for more information.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hotosm_stp_roads]

lineage.description: Road network data was collected through OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information contributions and exported by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team. The dataset contains approximately 1.3 thousand km of roads with attributes including highway classification, surface type, width, and lanes, representing approximately 80% of total road length based on AI-mapped estimates.
